description: This file manages session reflection cooldowns, stores and loads session learnings, and provides functions for cooldown enforcement and persistence of feedback-derived learning data.

methods.name: sanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Sanitizes session key to be filesystem-safe by replacing non-alphanumeric characters with underscores.

methods.name: pruneExpiredCooldowns
methods.description: Removes expired cooldown entries from the lastReflectionBySession map to prevent memory bloat.

methods.name: isReflectionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a session reflection is allowed based on cooldown timing.

methods.name: recordReflectionTime
methods.description: Records the current time as the last reflection time for a session and prunes expired entries.

methods.name: clearReflectionCooldowns
methods.description: Clears all stored reflection cooldown data, typically for testing.

methods.name: storeSessionLearning
methods.description: Stores a learning string associated with a session into a JSON file, maintaining a maximum of 10 entries.

methods.name: loadSessionLearnings
methods.description: Loads stored learnings for a session from a JSON file, returning an array of strings.
